system.description: A blast of bone-chilling air sweeps a 30' cone. Open flames in the cone go out.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, 2x damage, and creatures in the cone are Slowed on their next turn.
outcomes.success: Every creature in the cone takes 2d6 damage and is Deafened for d6 rounds by the howling.
outcomes.ruin: The cold bites you first: you are Slowed on your next turn. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
